claims.summary: Elevated Bian Prefecture to Kaifeng Prefecture as Eastern Capital and attached nine additional counties.

claims.event: Founded the Liang dynasty and established Kaifeng as Eastern Capital.

claims.about: Requested establishment of Xiu Prefecture from Jiaxing County of Hang Prefecture.

claims.summary: Memorialized to establish Xiu Prefecture from Jiaxing County of Hang Prefecture.

claims.event: Submitted a memorial as ruler of the Two Zhes concerning Xiu Prefecture.

claims.about: Requested establishing a prefecture from Xiangchuan County with Qingxiang County and Guanyang attached.

claims.summary: Memorialized to establish Xiang Prefecture from Xiangchuan County, create Qingxiang County, and attach Guanyang.

claims.event: Submitted a memorial as Hunan ruler concerning Xiang Prefecture.

claims.about: Memorial approving elevation of Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture to prefecture status with renamed Dechang and three attached counties.

claims.summary: His memorial was followed in elevating Quanyi to prefecture status as Pu Prefecture with Dechang and three counties attached.

claims.event: Memorial from Hunan ruler Ma Xifan was followed for Pu Prefecture arrangements.

claims.about: Requested that Linjing County be transferred from Jing Prefecture to Yuan Prefecture to provide the latter with a subordinate county.

claims.summary: Petitioned to transfer Linjing County to Yuan Prefecture; the request was approved.
